about: A page round a planet (r277, r347, docs/depth-tricks.md §3): the side of a world turning round one centre R under the middle of the view's bottom. Each IMAGE, SHADER and SEQUENCE layer is cut in 256 vertical strips across its view, each drawn as the quad its corners go to, x along the ground's arc and y along the radius: every layer alike, each turning at its own speed, what stands up leaning out. Godot draws its own quads (plax_planet.gd); jME runs core's PlanetBatch. Written by core/test-data/planet/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.
